repos.name: NVIDIA/OpenShell
repos.description: OpenShell is the safe, private runtime for autonomous AI agents.
repos.one_liner: A secure, private runtime environment designed specifically for the execution of autonomous AI agents.
bullets: Built in Rust for high-performance memory safety and low-latency execution.
Provides a sandboxed environment to isolate agent actions from host system resources.
Focuses on secure credential management and permission-based access control for agentic workflows.
Ideal for enterprise deployments requiring strict governance over autonomous AI operations.

repos.name: atilaahmettaner/tradingview-mcp
repos.description: TradingView MCP server — real-time market data, technical analysis, screeners & backtesting for Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor & any MCP client. Stocks, crypto, forex & futures across global exchanges. Hosted or self-host.
repos.one_liner: An MCP (Model Context Protocol) server that bridges TradingView market data and technical analysis tools to AI assistants.
bullets: Python-based implementation utilizing the Model Context Protocol for seamless LLM integration.
Provides real-time access to global stock, crypto, forex, and futures market data.
Enables AI agents to perform technical analysis, screening, and backtesting directly within chat interfaces like Claude or Cursor.
Perfect for quant developers building AI-driven trading research assistants.

repos.name: allenpeng0705/EnvoyMesh
repos.description: Decentralized P2P mesh for autonomous AI agents — self-sovereign identity, peer-to-peer chat, and on-device AI that negotiates tasks on your behalf. No central server.
repos.one_liner: A decentralized P2P mesh network designed for autonomous AI agents to communicate and negotiate tasks without central servers.
bullets: TypeScript-based architecture leveraging decentralized P2P protocols for agent-to-agent communication.
Integrates self-sovereign identity (SSI) to ensure secure and verifiable agent interactions.
Supports on-device AI task negotiation, reducing reliance on cloud-based orchestration.
Enables resilient, private infrastructure for multi-agent systems in distributed environments.

repos.name: VectifyAI/PageIndex
repos.description: 📑 PageIndex: Document Index for Vectorless, Reasoning-based RAG
repos.one_liner: A document indexing framework that enables reasoning-based RAG without the need for traditional vector databases.
bullets: Python-based indexing engine optimized for high-speed document retrieval and reasoning.
Eliminates the complexity of vector embeddings and vector database management.
Focuses on structured document parsing to improve LLM context accuracy and reasoning performance.
Suitable for developers looking to simplify RAG infrastructure while maintaining high retrieval quality.

repos.name: farion1231/cc-switch
repos.description: A cross-platform desktop All-in-One assistant for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, OpenClaw, Grok Build & Hermes Agent. Only official website: ccswitch.io
repos.one_liner: A cross-platform desktop assistant designed to manage and switch between various AI coding agents like Claude Code and OpenCode.
bullets: Rust-based desktop application ensuring high performance and cross-platform compatibility.
Acts as a unified control plane for managing multiple agentic coding tools and LLM-based development environments.
Simplifies the developer workflow by providing a single interface for agent configuration and execution.
Targeted at power users and engineers integrating multiple AI coding assistants into their daily development stack.
